Every conversation is a real Jan proof ask from the census (data/jan-asks-intake-fable-j1/census.md section 5); nothing here is invented. Per ask: the documents H3 filed (proof_intake + forensics F2 reuse and F5a kind), the latest stage-2 verdict per request x role (stage2_shadow, with its consecutive-undetermined count), the latest doc-verify read per request x role (dv_outcomes, with its consecutive-unknown count), the latest DSP anchor (dsp_verdicts), and the fraud lens measured on the same day (credit_review.fraud_lens.default_lens over the core replica: no hold and no watch hit for any of these accounts). `expected` holds the verdict counts the precedence must produce, the ask's next state, the campaign it names, and where the coded rule agrees or disagrees with the verdict a human hand-posted on 2026-11-04 - the disagreements are the point: each one is a stored verdict a person read differently, not an excuse to relax the rule.
